function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The population in the contract ('all penguins in the dataset') is interpreted as the set of penguins for which both variables are observed. Pearson correlation is mathematically defined only on complete pairs of data. The full 344-row population is not valid for the correlation because it includes rows with missing values in either variable. The estimand cannot be computed on the full dataset; it must be computed on the subset with complete data. This is standard practice and does not violate the contract — it clarifies the true population for the estimand. Thus, the population for the correlation is the 342 complete cases, which is correct and necessary."}
